description: BC Wildfire WUI Human Interface Buffer is a dataset listed in British Columbia data catalogue (BC Data Catalogue), an open data portal, published or maintained by BC Wildfire Service. The Wildland Urban Interface (WUI) buffer is defined as a maximum of two kilometers from the structure density class greater than 6. As defined in the FireSmart manual, the WUI is any area where combustible forest fuel is found adjacent to homes, farm structures or other outbuildings. Coverage: British Columbia. The portal files it under the publisher BC Wildfire Service. Its tags are BCWS, FIRE, PSTA, Prevention, Provincial Strategic Threat Analysis. It offers 5 resource(s) in FGDB, KML, MULTIPLE, OTHER, WMS. The portal shows 2026-08-06 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Access Only. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bc-portal.
